verdict.rationale: Versioning automations is a fair question for a note-taking app that offers saved custom AI prompts, deep links and Zapier connections. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review or rollback for any automation. The documented note history (revert a note to any point in time) covers note content, not automations, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
